definition: [ נוּט ] verb dangle, shake ( ᵑ7 [ נוט ] Aph`el scare , sld., Levy ChWB ii. 97 Jastr Dict. 886 ; Arabic a bag hanging down , suspend, hang ); — Qal Imperfect 3 feminine singular תָּנוּט Ps 99:1 let (the earth) shake (|| רָגַז ). — Ol We proposes תָּמוּג . נוית see below I. נוה .
